emr.ai.title: Superman Bot
emr.ai.homeDesc: Ask about a tagged record: summary, codes, labs, medication, claim readiness. No medical advice.
emr.ai.empty: Tag a visit (Ask assistant in any window, or search below), then pick a question or type e.g. “summarize”, “diagnoses”, “flagged labs”, “claim readiness”.
emr.ai.subject: Ask about {label}
emr.ai.chooseVisitHint: Several visits are tagged. Choose the visit to ask about (select its chip).
emr.ai.reply.refuse: I can't give medical advice, diagnoses or treatment recommendations. I can show what the record contains — try “summarize”, “diagnoses” or “flagged labs”.
emr.ai.reply.help: I can read back a tagged record: summary · diagnoses (ICD-10) · procedures (ICD-9-CM) · flagged labs · medications · claim readiness.
emr.ai.reply.needTag: Tag a visit first (Ask assistant in a window, or search a no_rawat).
emr.ai.reply.needVisit: Patient MRN {mrn} is tagged. Tag the visit you are asking about (Ask assistant in that visit, or search below); I don't pick a visit for you.
emr.ai.reply.chooseVisit: {n} visits are tagged. Choose the one you mean (select its chip below), then ask again; I don't pick a visit for you.
emr.ai.reply.notLoaded: Visit {norawat} is still loading — ask again in a moment.
emr.ai.reply.summary: {setting, select, inpatient {Inpatient} outpatient {Outpatient} other {Care setting not recorded}} · DPJP {dpjp} · length of stay {los} · status {status}. Coded diagnoses:
